name: Lightdash
description: Open-source business intelligence tool that turns dbt models into a self-serve analytics and dashboard layer.

envVars.description: Secret key used to encrypt sessions and credentials
Password for the Lightdash Postgres database

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PGHOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      PGPORT: 5432
      PGDATABASE: lightdash
      PGUSER: lightdash
      PGPASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      LIGHTDASH_SECRET: {{env.LIGHTDASH_SECRET}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/usr/app/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: lightdash
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: lightdash
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
